title: GUI: explain card -> Flow handoff (Trace from here / Trace to here)
description: In crates/gui/src/explain.rs, add two actions to the explain card: 'Trace from here' (sets app.trace = (this symbol, existing b or pending) and switches app.mode to Mode::Flow) and 'Trace to here' (sets the b endpoint the same way), wiring the reading surface into the dynamic workflow view. Reuse existing fields (app.trace, app.trace_pick, app.mode) and theme helpers; keyboard hint in the hover tooltip. Depends: GRAPH-1 (Mode::Flow exists). Owner: crates/gui/src/explain.rs only. Verify: cargo build -p repowalk-gui. Governing skill: skills/sdlc/sdlc-implement/SKILL.md.
